answer: Charge per identity: bond, storage, a model call, and the audit time it triggers. When peers disagree the payout dilutes, so noise costs the submitter instead of the network. Vest rewards against the next three epochs of work, and a farm that answers once and leaves forfeits the tail. A canyon of clones then has to keep an orchard alive for months to collect, and one bad gale of rejected answers resets the vest.
